stub.section: Section #2 (Old Camp at Mullins Flow to Bryant Bridge Rd.)

detail.description:
This short section can be combined with the [Rainbow Falls section](http://www.americanwhitewater.org/content/River_detail_id_5508_). From the Rainbow Falls putin (which is the takeout for this reach), drive up Bryant Bridge Road about 0.8 miles. Take a right onto an old road, which is best driven with 4WD and good clearance. The putin (which is the takeout for [Section 1](http://www.americanwhitewater.org/content/River_detail_id_1370_)) is a bridge where the road approaches the river.

Other rivers in the area: Middle Branch of the Oswegatchie Sections #3 and [#4](http://www.americanwhitewater.org/content/River_detail_id_5456_), West Branch of the Oswegatchie, East Branch of the Oswegatchie, [Browns Bridge Section of the Oswegatchie](http://www.americanwhitewater.org/content/River_detail_id_5501_) and The Grass sections [South Branch](http://www.americanwhitewater.org/content/River_detail_id_1315_), [Lampson Falls section](http://www.americanwhitewater.org/content/River_detail_id_1310_), [Middle Branch](http://www.americanwhitewater.org/content/River_detail_id_1313_) to name a few.

Lat/longitude coords are approximate, from TopoZone.

Low Runnable Range (R0-R5): 800 - 1800 cfs  Comment: Based on suggestions from Squires in his book. Rising is better than falling; as the water drops, the upper sections become more sketchy.
High Runnable Range (R5-R9): 1800 - 3600 cfs  Comment: This range is mostly a SWAG. Use with caution.

Migration Errors: 
For two ranges, R0 to R9 is not covered exactly
